verdict.rationale: Devin docs mention a permission system for MCP tools that can be controlled 'at multiple levels' (devin-docs-13), and human-in-the-loop touchpoints like taking over in the IDE or interactive browser exist, but there is no documented org-wide tiered autonomy setting that lets an engineering lead configure confirmation thresholds for the agent's own actions. missing for 10: explicit autonomy-level/permission-tier configuration UI or API for engineering leads, granular confirmation-required settings beyond MCP tool access, and independent evidence of this control being used in practice.
